purpose: Development experiment. Test whether shrinking the no-pawn residual improves decisions on a new mix of positions. Production admission is outside this protocol.
split: SHA-256 of UTF-8 'eval-robustness-v1' + NUL + source group ID. First eight bytes unsigned big-endian modulo ten. Buckets 0 through 2 are held out, all other buckets fit. Before fitting or scoring, exclude every game sharing any root/child symmetry cluster or structural family with an original primary role, the old independent OOD selection, or the historical repository quarantine. Use only identity metadata for this check.
model: hce + alpha * (noPawn - hce). Shared scale, no bias, no additional board scans. Train on continuous scores, export alpha on a 1/16 grid. Evaluation uses signed division truncating toward zero after multiplication.
loss: Mean per group, then root. At each root use 75% mean binary cross-entropy over every unordered pair of alternative children, using teacher score difference and 120 cp temperature; 25% mean binary cross-entropy over children using teacher score and 250 cp temperature. Targets are sigmoids. Add 0.0025 * alpha^2. Fit box [0,1] via the monotone derivative; quantize its minimizer to the nearest grid point (ties toward the smaller numerator).
ablations: Same fit data. Also report scales and held-out decision diagnostics for no penalty, tenfold penalty and pointwise-only with the primary penalty. Use the declared primary recipe in games regardless of their results.
heldout: Primary diagnostic is mean teacher regret of the top-scoring available child, averaged over roots within each source group then over groups. Break predicted ties by ascending UCI; allow any tied teacher best move to count as correct. Pairwise ordering excludes equal teacher scores and awards a half for a tied prediction. Also report severe (>=150 cp) regret, static errors and slices by candidate moves giving capture/promotion/check and whether the teacher-best set contains such a move. Clamp absolute teacher scores to +/-2000 cp for MAE, regret and numeric gap metrics. The collector maps mates near +/-3000, retaining the distance; the numeric diagnostic cap applies equally to those labels. Top agreement and ordering use the original teacher scores. Drop entire held-out roots if any root or child board/side/castling/en-passant key occurs in the calibration training data. No slice chooses a model.
uncertainty: Held-out primary regret differences use 5000 percentile bootstrap draws resampling paired source groups with replacement, seed 20261127. These describe a development screen and do not estimate equal-time game strength.
